verdict.rationale: Shopify's Agentic Commerce/UCP evidence is entirely about buyers purchasing merchant products (catalog search, carts, checkout, orders) via MCP tools and AP2 payment mandates — it is not an HTTP 402 pay-per-call API monetization infrastructure for arbitrary developer APIs/services. This story targets a different product category (machine-payment gateways like x402), which is outside Shopify's commerce-platform scope, so the axis does not apply here.
